decisive_items: gallium-68 DOTATATE PET/MRI showed a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head
response.rationale: R1 is the only candidate and is directly supported by hypophosphatemia, elevated FGF23, and a DOTATATE-avid intracortical lesion, which together are diagnostic of tumor-induced osteomalacia. No competing candidate was supplied for comparison.
